name: eff
description: Independent orchestration (graph, blitz, toss) and skill-maintenance (update-skills, dedupe-skills, prune-skills) skills under the eff namespace for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Focused workflows for faster, verified agent work
interface.longDescription: Use independent orchestration and skill-maintenance skills from one installation. Graph selects and executes validated work graphs; Blitz forces overlapping work into isolated parallel slices, merges the results, and enforces a verification gate; Toss hands work-in-progress to a background agent and closes it out with time, tokens, and a summary; Update Skills previews and applies latest versions of installed skills; Dedupe Skills finds overlapping skills and removes redundancy; Prune Skills removes never-used skills based on real usage data.
defaultPrompt: Use $eff:graph to orchestrate this as a validated work graph.
Use $eff:blitz to parallelize this work and merge it safely.
Use $eff:toss to hand this work to a background agent and keep the session free.
Use $eff:update-skills to check installed skills for updates and apply the ones I confirm.
Use $eff:dedupe-skills to find overlapping or conflicting skills and help me remove the redundant ones.
Use $eff:prune-skills to measure which skills I actually use and help me remove the dead weight.
